eta_support: three consecutive directed edges = four consecutive vertex labels

heldout_generation.method: lexicographic enumeration of 12-bit halves h in {1,2}^12; form h||(3-h); group by all directed pair correlations; choose first group with differing N2121 outside R131/R132 dihedral orbits

interpretation.three_node: The same oriented local functional distinguishes through eps and eta; reflection-invariant coefficients erase the distinction.
interpretation.heldout: The same frozen local feature family separates a new 24-node pair with identical all-shift three-point counts.
